text: A stern letter from his father. A note from the family solicitor. A demand from Lloyds Bank about an overdraft of seventy-nine pounds, nineteen shillings and twopence. Theatre ticket stubs. A bill for four nights at the Naval and Military Club. Keys, cigarettes, stamps, a silver cross and a St Christopher medallion. Together, they traced a man's last week in London, from the 18th to the 24th of April.
